title: Ranch House Backyard, Rumpus Room Windows - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Rear view of house. Three large windows at left is rumpus room.

9 5 7 C
description: A deckled-edge black-and-white snapshot showing the rear facade of a mid-century suburban home, characterized by flat or low-pitch rooflines, a covered back porch with slender supports, and a grassy backyard with garden shrubs. A child stands beside the foundation under the three large windows of the rumpus room. The scene reflects post-World War II American residential architecture and the burgeoning suburban culture emphasizing informal family recreation spaces.
